I almost stopped mid-treatment. I wonder if I'm the only one who experienced this?

The treatment plan wasn't explained in detail.
I called to schedule an appointment, but received a missed call and wasn't called back.
When I called again, the first thing they said was, "Please don't call again." There wasn't even a "hello." And I paid for this service myself, every single penny.

restaurant_name: คลินิกทันตกรรมพอส POSS Dental Clinic สาขาลำลูกกาคลองสอง
text: The doctor is very thorough and attentive to patients. I recommend him.

restaurant_name: คลินิกทันตกรรมพอส POSS Dental Clinic สาขาลำลูกกาคลองสอง
text: I went to the dentist for a price estimate, and it was very expensive. So I only chose to get the specific areas I needed treated. The total after the procedure was almost 5,000 baht. The assistant seemed inexperienced; the dentist had to constantly explain things to her. The dentist kept touching my face and mouth with her clean instruments, even using her gown to brush against my head several times. Before finishing, the dentist checked my teeth and said everything was fine. However, when I got back to my room and looked again, there were still some tartar particles stuck between my teeth. I think patients shouldn't have to spend time picking at tartar buildup after leaving the clinic. The price was high, but the work was terrible. I spent almost 5,000 baht for very poor service.
